players.bio: Braydon Marvin Manu is a professional footballer who plays as a forward or right winger for Dutch Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle.
Dylan Mbayo (born 11 October 2001) is a Belgian professional footballer who plays for Dutch Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle .

Elias Fritjof Grænge Sørensen (born 18 September 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a striker for Norwegian club Vålerenga. After playing youth football for Danish club HB Køge, Sørensen became Køge's youngest ever player after coming on as a late substitute against Silkeborg on 8 May 2016 at the age of 16.
Henry van der Vegt (born 18 February 1972) is a Dutch football coach and former player who is head coach at PEC Zwolle.
Ibrahim Cissoko (born 26 March 2003) is a Guinean-Dutch professional footballer who plays as a left winger for English EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers on loan from French club Toulouse.

Jan Jakub Faberski is a Polish professional footballer who plays as a winger, attacking midfielder or wide midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle, on loan from Eerste Divisie club Jong Ajax. Club career Early career Faberski started his youth career with Hutnik Warsaw.
Jasper Schendelaar (born 2 September 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eerste Divisie club PEC Zwolle.

Koen Kostons (born 18 September 1999) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. Career MVV Kostons progressed through MVV's youth academy, joining their setup as a thirteen-year-old from boyhood club Lanaken VV.

Nick Viergever (born 3 August 1989) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a defender for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. On 7 May 2012, Viergever was one of nine uncapped players named in the provisional list of 36 players for the Euro 2012 tournament by Netherlands manager Bert van Marwijk. He did not make the final cut.
Odysseus Velanas (born 5 June 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. Born in Greece, he has represented the Netherlands at youth level.
Olivier Aertssen (born 7 August 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle.

Ryan Jared Thomas (born 20 December 1994) is a New Zealand professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle and the New Zealand national team. Thomas played for various clubs across the Waikato region of New Zealand, before signing professional terms with Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle in 2013.

Samir Lagsir (born 20 May 2003) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Dutch club PEC Zwolle. Club career On 10 September 2019, Lagsir signed his first professional contract with PEC Zwolle. Lagsir made his debut as a late sub with PEC Zwolle in a 5-1 Eredivisie loss to FC Twente on 31 October 2020.
Sherel Floranus (born 23 August 1998) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. Born in the Netherlands, he plays for the Curaçao national team.

Shola Maxwell Shoretire is an English professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder or winger for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle, on loan from Super League Greece club PAOK. Shoretire signed his first professional contract with Manchester United on 8 February 2021, a week after turning 17.

Simon Graves Jensen (born 22 May 1999) is a Danish professional footballer who plays for Dutch Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle as a centre-back. Graves started playing football at Holstebro Boldklub before joining the Randers FC youth academy at under-17 level. In January 2018, he signed his first professional contract, a three-year deal.
Sydney van Hooijdonk (born 6 February 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre forward for Eredivisie club NAC Breda.
Thijs Oosting (born 2 May 2000) is a Dutch football player who plays for side PEC Zwolle, on loan from Groningen.
Thomas Buitink (born 14 June 2000) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a forward for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle.

Tijs Velthuis is a 24-year-old Dutch professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for the Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle. Born on 12 January 2002 in Oldenzaal, Netherlands, he is a tall, left-footed defender measuring 1.89 metres (6 feet 2 inches). Career Velthuis joined NAC Breda on a season-long loan deal on 13 July 2022, with an option to buy.
Tobias Sommer Sørensen (born 27 November 2001) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or defensive midfielder for Danish Superliga club Sønderjyske.
Tom Gerard de Graaff (born 10 December 2004) is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Eredivisie club PEC Zwolle, on loan from Utrecht.
